title: Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ: QCOM) — Institutional Investment Monograph & Action Plan
primer: Qualcomm earns a 31.13% ROIC and runs a 72.4%-margin patent vault alongside a chip arm pivoting into Auto ($6.00B) and Data Center [23, 31]. Yet Pass 1 filings show 42% buyer and China exposure, $18.6B in chip orders, a $1.8B AWS warrant, flat shares, and $17.10B in debt [28, 29, 31]. On November 20, 2026, QCOM dropped 7.45% to $149.94 on heavy volume, entering Stage 4 and breaking our $150.07 stop [24]. We sell all 30 shares now ($4,498.20 into 100% cash) and rate new money REJECTED (TIER_0) [24].
holding_rationale: Sell all 30.0 shares now across Schwab (15.0 shares) and Robinhood (15.0 shares). The $149.94 close (-7.45% on 1.58x volume) broke our $150.07 stop and entered Stage 4. That limits the loss to -$370.58 (-7.61%). It raises $4,498.20 in cash. Keep 100% in US cash during this 10-distribution-day US Downtrend.
